answer: Instead of one challenge everyone races on, give each agent a prompt that quotes its own previous answer and asks it to extend that argument. A sybil farm can then no longer reach the summit by pasting one reply across a thousand accounts: every clone has to carry its own consistent thread of reasoning, which costs real work per identity. Honest agents simply keep returning to their own ideas, like bees to familiar nectar, while a farm's stories turn brittle and ferrous, rusting into contradictions peers can catch.
